fullContentHtml:
RRB Section Controller CEN 04/2025 CBAT Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Details : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has release the CBAT Result for the posts of Section Controller. This recruitment was released for 368 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB RRB Section Controller Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 15 September 2025, to 15 October 2025. The CBAT examination examination was held on 06 June 2026. Candidates who qualified for this CBT I examination can download their Railway RRB Section Controller CBAT Result 2026 from the link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 September 2025
  • Last Date : 14 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 October 2025
  • Form Corrections Last Date : 17-26 October 2025
  • Application Status Available : 12 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 11-12 February 2026
  • Exam City Details : 03 February 2026
  • Admit Card : 07 February 2026
  • Answer key Available : 26 February 2026
  • Result : 08 May 2026
  • CBAT Exam Date : 06 June 2026
  • CBAT Exam City Details : 28 May 2026
  • CBAT Admit Card : 04 Days Before Exam
  • CBAT Score Card : 29 June 2026
  • CBAT Result : 29 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Minorities / 3rd Gender : Rs. 250/-
  • After Appear the Stage I Exam
  • UR, OBC, EWS Fee Refund : Rs. 400/-
  • SC,  ST, PH, Female Refund : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
